faqs.question: Why should I upgrade from NAV to Business Central?
faqs.answer: Business Central offers cloud scalability, enhanced security, modern features, and better integration compared to NAV.

faqs.question: How long does an ERP upgrade take?
faqs.answer: Upgrade timelines vary based on data complexity and customizations, but most projects take 3–6 months.

faqs.question: Can my existing customizations be retained?
faqs.answer: Yes, we migrate or rebuild legacy customizations in Business Central to ensure continuity.

faqs.question: Will there be downtime during migration?
faqs.answer: We use phased migration strategies to minimize downtime and disruption to operations.

faqs.question: Do you offer post-upgrade support?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide ongoing support, training, and system optimization after go-live.
